PFY_XINTAKE_TIMEOUT is documented as a float number of seconds > 0. xintake_timeout() turns a bad value into the default and main() still calls the entry. A set value that is not a finite number > 0 must exit 2 before the entry runs.

Add import math.

Add this function next to xintake_timeout():

def timeout_problem() -> str | None:
    """PFY_XINTAKE_TIMEOUT must be a finite number of seconds > 0 when set; xintake_timeout() would quietly use the default instead."""
    raw = os.environ.get("PFY_XINTAKE_TIMEOUT", "")
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return None
    raw = raw.strip()
    try:
        v = float(raw)
    except ValueError:
        v = math.nan
    if math.isfinite(v) and v > 0:
        return None
    return f"PFY_XINTAKE_TIMEOUT={raw[:40]!r} is not a number of seconds > 0"

In main(), after the receipt dict is built and before the line that calls the entry function:

    bad = timeout_problem()
    if bad:
        receipt["reason"] = bad
        return write(a.entry, receipt, 2)

In the module docstring, replace "empty or invalid keeps the default." with "Empty keeps the default. Any other set value (abc, 0, -1, nan, inf) exits 2 before the entry runs."
